notes: Shared by desktop (grit resource) and iOS (bundle resource). Each entry's `definition` goes to the Messages API as is; `scope` stays local: `page` tools act on the session's target tab, `browser` tools need the "Let Claude use the whole browser" setting and are refused without it. Coordinates are in the pixel space of the latest screenshot. See docs/design/claude.md. `platforms`, when present, lists where a tool exists ("desktop", "ios"); without it, everywhere.

definition.name: read_page
definition.description: Read the current tab as a tree of visible elements: role, accessible name, state, and a ref id (like "e12") for every element you can act on. Refs stay the same across reads of the same document. Use filter "interactive" for a short list of controls only. Prefer this over screenshots to find things to click or fill.

filter.description: "all" (default) includes headings, text and structure; "interactive" lists only links, buttons, fields and other controls.

ref.description: Read only the subtree under this ref.

max_chars.description: Cut the output after this many characters (default 20000).

definition.name: get_page_text
definition.description: Get the main text of the current tab as plain text (article body when one is found, otherwise the whole page), with its title and URL.

max_chars.description: Cut the output after this many characters (default 50000).

definition.name: find
definition.description: Find elements in the current tab whose accessible name, text, label, placeholder or value contains the query (case-insensitive). Returns matching elements with their ref, role and name.

definition.name: screenshot
definition.description: Take a screenshot of the visible part of the current tab. Coordinates for click, hover and scroll are in this image's pixels.

ref.description: Scroll this element into view first.

definition.name: read_console
definition.description: Read the current tab's JavaScript console: console.* messages, uncaught errors and unhandled promise rejections, oldest first, with level, text, source location and time.

only_new.description: Only messages since the last read_console in this chat (default true).

pattern.description: Only messages whose text matches this regular expression.

limit.description: At most this many messages, the most recent ones (default 100).

definition.name: run_js
definition.description: Run JavaScript in the current tab's page, as if typed in its console. The value of the last expression is returned as JSON; a returned promise is awaited. Use it to inspect state, not to bypass the page's own UI when the user asked you to use it.

definition.name: click
definition.description: Click an element by ref, or a point in the latest screenshot. The click goes to the page only; the user's own mouse is not moved.

coordinate.description: [x, y] in screenshot pixels. Use ref when you have one.

modifiers.description: Keys held during the click, joined with +: shift, ctrl, alt, cmd (e.g. "cmd+shift").

definition.name: hover
definition.description: Move the page's pointer over an element by ref, or a point in the latest screenshot, to show menus or tooltips. The user's own mouse is not moved.

definition.name: type
definition.description: Type text into the focused element, or into the element given by ref (it is focused first). Text is inserted where the caret is; use form_input to replace a field's whole value.

definition.name: key
definition.description: Press keys in the page: one key or combo, or several separated by spaces, e.g. "Enter", "Tab Tab", "cmd+a Backspace", "Escape", "ArrowDown". Use cmd on macOS and ctrl elsewhere for shortcuts.

repeat.description: Press the whole sequence this many times (default 1).

definition.name: scroll
definition.description: Scroll the page, or the scrollable area under a ref or a point.

amount.description: In steps of about a third of the viewport (default 3).

definition.name: form_input
definition.description: Set a form field's value by ref: text fields and text areas (replaces the value), selects (by option value or visible text), checkboxes and radios (true or false). Fires the page's input and change events.

definition.name: navigate
definition.description: Load a URL in the current tab, or go "back", "forward" or "reload". Waits for the page to load (up to 15 seconds).

url.description: An http(s) URL, or one of "back", "forward", "reload".

definition.name: wait
definition.description: Wait before the next step, for a page to finish loading or animating.

definition.name: list_tabs
definition.description: List the browser's tabs as the sidebar shows them: every space with its Favorites, Pinned entries (in folders) and Today entries, loaded or not, then tabs in other windows. Each entry has a tab_id for the other tools (folders have a folder_id) and marks: [front] (shown in its window), [you act on this], [you opened it], [unloaded], [muted], [playing]. The space the user's window shows is marked.

definition.name: open_tab
definition.description: Open a URL in a new tab in the current window's space. It opens in the background unless active is true, and becomes the tab you act on.

active.description: Bring it to the front (default false).

definition.name: select_tab
definition.description: Make the page tools act on another tab, by tab_id from list_tabs. It doesn't bring the tab to the front; an unloaded entry of the shown space is loaded in the background.

definition.name: close_tab
definition.description: Close a tab by tab_id. A pinned or favorite entry stays in the sidebar, unloaded, unless remove is true; a Today tab goes away. Before closing or removing tabs the user didn't ask you to close, ask them.

remove.description: Also remove a pinned or favorite entry from the sidebar (default false).

definition.name: activate_tab
definition.description: Show a tab to the user: bring it to the front of their window, switching the window to the tab's space or loading it if needed. The page tools act on it.

definition.name: move_tab
definition.description: Move a tab (or a split) in the sidebar: reorder it, pin it (to: pinned), unpin it (to: today), add it to or take it out of Favorites, put it in a folder (to: folder, folder_id), or move it to another space (space). index is its position among its new siblings: 0 is first, default last.

space.description: A space's name or id, for another space (default: the tab's own).

definition.name: rename_tab
definition.description: Give a tab its own name in the sidebar; an empty title goes back to the page's title.

definition.name: create_folder
definition.description: Create a folder in a space's Pinned or Today section, or in another folder. Returns its folder_id, for move_tab.

space.description: A space's name or id (default: the one the user's window shows).

definition.name: mute_tab
definition.description: Mute or unmute a tab's sound.

definition.name: split_tabs
definition.description: Show two tabs side by side (a split view) in the sidebar and the window. move_tab of a pane takes it out of the split.

definition.name: switch_space
definition.description: Show another space in the user's window, by name or id from list_tabs.

definition.name: create_space
definition.description: Create a space, and show it in the user's window if show is true.

definition.name: search_history
definition.description: Search the browsing history by words in titles and URLs, newest first.

query.description: Empty lists the most recent visits.

days.description: Only the last this many days.

definition.name: list_downloads
definition.description: List recent downloads, newest first: file name, URL, state, size and where it's saved.

definition.name: send_tab_to_device
definition.description: Send a tab to one of the user's other devices that sync with Compass; it shows there as a notification. Without device, lists the devices.

tab_id.description: Default: the tab you act on.

device.description: A device's name, from the list.
